_comment: SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for the customer-golden oracle's field taxonomy. Every field the customer's prod beacons carry is bucketed here so nothing can be silently dropped to game the score. GATED = must value-match ours vs prod (after documented normalization); PRESENCE = must be present + correct shape but is NOT value-matched, with a per-field REASON why it cannot match across two independent captures. The PRESENCE list is FROZEN: the loop reads it read-only; moving a field GATED->PRESENCE is a reviewed contract change, never something an iteration does. Buckets grounded in the empirical determinism analysis of the 161 payloads (all captured in ONE authenticated session). Ratified 2026-08-26 (freeze per-visit + browser-fingerprint + time-varying as present+shape).
_thresholdNote: PASS = MIN across every axis >= threshold: overall gated value-match, per-event-type, per-component, per-gated-field, AND coverage (reproduced/161); PLUS 100% present-and-shape on the frozen list. A blended mean is NOT allowed — the weakest axis is the score.

host._note: cross-env: our stage host is rewritten to the prod host before comparing any host-bearing value. Documented + reviewed — NOT silent stripping.

env._note: if our stage build reports env=stage, it is mapped to prod before compare; if it already reports prod, no-op. Confirm live which it emits.

normalize._stripTagsNote: prod authors HTML into these (e.g. faq questions wrapped in <span>); both sides are tag-stripped before compare. Fixed rule.

gated._note: value-match ours vs prod. Threshold applies per-field, per-event, per-component.

event._note: must equal object:action AND match prod's event

_metadata._note: Segment integration-routing config (bundled/unbundled); deterministic for the account

event._note: echoed event name; same rule as envelope.event

object_detail._note: positional index segments (faq|question_N) normalized before compare — prod's faq question numbers are AUTHORED + scrambled (don't track DOM order, and repeat: two questions share question_5), so the STRUCTURE faq|question_N must match but the exact number is not meaningful. Non-numeric object_detail (nav|schedule_demo, talktosales|open_widget, logo_nav|turbotax) is untouched by idxNorm.

ui_object._note: positional index segments (accordion_item_N) normalized before compare — same rationale as object_detail/ui_access_point: prod's accordion N is authored + scrambled (doesn't track DOM order), so the STRUCTURE accordion_item_N must match but the exact number is not meaningful. Non-index ui_objects (button/link/video_link/rw_carousel_control) are untouched.

ui_access_point._note: computed data-tracking trail — comes from block wiring, the sheet CANNOT fake it. indexTolerant: positional index segments (rw_card_N, accordion_item_N) are normalized before compare — the trail STRUCTURE must match, but card_1 vs card_2 is accepted (index shifts with our exact markup/payload order; what matters is that the beacon fires with the right shape).

link_name._note: may embed the positional ui_object (e.g. accordion_item_1) — index-normalized like ui_access_point (live-verified 2026-08-26: stage vs prod faq differ only by item index)

link_href._note: navigation-derived — the offline synthetic replica can't observe it; value-matched only by the live gate

gpc_enabled._note: deterministic given the accept-all consent our runner sets

page_cas_id._note: Content identifier is now the page PATHNAME (OVERRIDES.md / APPVARS.md: externalContentIdentifier = window.location.pathname; there is no cas-id metadata anymore). The frozen golden holds the OLD prod CMS id (e.g. c14O6fD4y), so we do NOT value-match it — resolveWant() substitutes the entry's own pathname as the expectation, gated present + equals-pathname (trailing-slash tolerant). Beacon omitting it, or sending anything other than the pathname, is still a real gap.

personalization_details._note: prod = [] on these pages; GATED so any pzn injection on our side shows as a real diff

presenceFrozen._note: present + correct-shape ONLY. FROZEN — the loop cannot add to this. Each entry states WHY it cannot value-match across two independent captures.

userId.reason: authed user id (their capture = a real user)

page_track_seq_num.reason: event sequence within the visit; depends on click order/count

ivid.reason: Intuit visitor id; session-locked to their capture

akes_geo.reason: visitor geo (their tester = US~WA); depends where the runner executes

experiment_ids.reason: live A/B assignments at capture time; change as experiments start/stop

page.reason: url/path echo; presence + shape (value covered by properties.url after host-normalize)

structuralExceptions._comment: FROZEN. Prod beacons our click-tracking genuinely cannot reproduce, each with a reason. Excluded from the gated axes but still ENUMERATED in coverage (never a silent drop). The loop CANNOT add here — if an iteration concludes something is unreproducible, it must STOP and emit the stuck-report for human review; a human ratifies any addition. Everything fixable (banner/feature not ported, faq accordion semantics, derive gaps) is NOT an exception and must be fixed.

byEvent.chat:viewed: passive chat-widget render impression (object=chat, ui_action=displayed) — fires when the widget displays, not on a click; there is no EDS click-tracking equivalent to reproduce it
